author: goldenwalrus909
body:
Hey, Goldie here!

Before falling asleep yesterday, this idea suddenly popped into my head: what if on your "My Profile" page, there was a box that told everyone how many total words you typed on the forums. Me, an extensively-writing forum user, would really enjoy this. I spend a lot of time on the forums writing and trying to help people and/or support their ideas and their accomplishments. I think it would be a great way to see if someone is one one of those people who says "+1" or writes a miniature essay on it (Nothing bad with either of those) xD  I don't know, I just feel like it would be a great way to see how much work someone puts into the forums, so they can get recognized a little more. Of course, a word would count as a correctly-spelled combination of letters that is either separated by spaces or other symbols: []{}()|-_=. If you have any ideas, approval, or criticism, please comment below! (:

-Love, Goldie :3

replies.author: goldenwalrus909
replies.body: I see where you're coming from, but I don't really agree. Look at your targets and nemeses, and your location and interests. None of those are important; they just give your profile some extra awesomeness and tell people more about you. Of course the words typed on the forums won't be super useful, but they'll give you recognition of how much effort you put into strengthening the community and tell more about you, just like the other things :3
